title: Mixed Event — Beside Unchanging Warmth — Episode2 To The New Year's Sales!

meta.Episode: Episode2 — To The New Year's Sales!
meta.Event Outline: One day in December, Mizuki's sister sends word from abroad that she'll be coming to visit, to Mizuki's delight. Warm memories resurface, of a time long ago when the two of them went shopping together. And so, Mizuki extends an invitation to go once again.

rows.Line: January 2 - New Year's Sales
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, these sales are as packed as ever...
We'll need to do our best not to get separated.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Right. So, where do you want to go first? You said there are lucky bags you've been eyeing, right, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, the ones from the shop I've been visiting a lot lately! Everything they have is really cute because they're super picky about which buttons, lace patterns and stuff they use.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but we should also see all the places you wanna check out today, Sis! It's been so long since you were last here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Hehe. I've been so excited about our little excursion that I went ahead and did some research beforehand♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, we can get lucky bags at that shop you were just talking about and then head over to the ones I'd like to see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, right this way!

Whoa, Shiho, look!
I won a really nice coupon!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That sounded like...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Mizuki? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...? No, nothing's wrong!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hmm... Was I just hearing things?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Between these spinning tops, Karuta and Daruma Otoshi, we should have more than enough fun things to do during New Year's!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, Rin and the others are going to be so thrilled! Thank you both again for taking me shopping!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'm relieved since writing down our resolutions was about the only New Year's-related activity we've been able to do with the things we have in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, this is the least we can do considering how much you guys have helped us in the past.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I still can't believe how seriously you guys were practicing doing calligraphy for your resolutions when we visited right at the end of the year!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Haha. Sorry, we didn't mean to startle you or anything.>
bgm_area00001
A few days earlier

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh... The end got all blotchy...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Flicking the brush just right is so difficult.
You can't do it too hard, but not too softly either...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
Wait, huh...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why are you all doing calligraphy?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're all here!
Sorry for not realizing sooner. We were all so focused.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
New Year's is coming up, yes?
We thought that we should practice writing our resolutions.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
Shiho, didn't you use to take calligraphy lessons?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me? Yeah, but...
That was way back in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would you mind showing us how to flick our brushes just right? We can't seem to figure out quite how to do it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I probably won't be able to teach you guys much, but if that's okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, please teach us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, you guys are working on right-side flicks...? In that case, you just have to stop the brush at the base of your stroke and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Gently push your brush outward while slowly lifting it in the air. Follow through completely and the ink shouldn't break or blotch.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Gently push the brush outward...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I think I did better this time...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, MEIKO, no fair!
Shih, help me too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Don't act so selfish.
Shiho and the others have to practice. We can just ask MEIKO to teach us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you for being our calligraphy teacher, Shiho. I think everyone's happy with their improvements, and it's all because you were willing to stop by so many times to give us lessons.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I wouldn't call them lessons...
But I'm glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've bought everything we need, let's start heading back...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, wait!
We should grab some souvenirs before we do!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how Ichi and Hona couldn't come today because they were both busy with stuff at home?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's right.
They might really enjoy it if we got a little gift for them.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Exactly! Also...
I wanna get something for Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He's been working super duper hard lately, so I'm gonna give him my support by buying him a present!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He's been working that hard?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, he basically spends all of his free time at home practicing. He's even started reading all these books he normally wouldn't so he can learn more about acting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, he's been going to see shows with Emu and the others for the same reason.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. He certainly seems passionate.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That means we'll need to pick out something extra nice for him.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, let's go check out our options.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! Why don't you get Shizuku something...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, because she's also been working super duper hard for MMJ!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I bet she'd be beside herself with joy if she got a present from you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Yeah, she has been really busy lately...
She also has to keep working during New Year's because of that livestream.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's always showing her support for us, so I guess I should return the favor for a change.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Then, as thanks for helping me find these New Year's toys, I'd like to help you two with your presents!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We really appreciate it, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's start looking!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew. That was a huge line, but we managed to get what we wanted!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Lining up early was the right call!
They only had about ten left.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right?! The thought of them running out gave me goosebumps!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Sis, mind if I take a look inside this lucky bag? I really wanna see what I got!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And if I look now, I'll know what stuff to get later to match!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Good idea! Then, let's take a seat on that bench over there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: It's supposed to include two tops, two bottoms and an accessory, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, my accessory's a scrunchie...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This purple color feels kinda grown-up, but the frills are so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I bet it'd look great on Mafuyu...!
I should ask her to try it on sometime!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ As for the tops...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
I think that pink shirt's going to look great on you, Mizuki! No, I absolutely guarantee it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you think so...?
Because I do! The lace on the sleeves is really cute and fluffy! This one's definitely a keeper!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hmm... Okay, change of plans!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I was originally planning on having you join me on my shopping spree next, but I want to find some bottoms for this shirt now...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For this? Weren't there some shops you really wanted to check out...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: They can wait!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Ever since you said that we'd be going to the New Year's sales together, I've been really excited about picking out clothes with you since it's been so long.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, please let me pick out an outfit for you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sis...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe... Then, if you don't mind♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's see what else is in this bag first! Where's that other top...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It really is fun to go shopping with her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Also... I can't really explain why, but I feel so much more relaxed when I'm around her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's just like old times...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I feel that I can be myself...
I don't have to worry about anything else.)
